properties.title: Hotels
properties.subtitle: Ultra-Luxury Kinetic Walkthrough Residence
properties.subtitleFa: Exclusive architectural estate with interactive tour

rooms.name: Twilight Pool Approach
rooms.subtitle: Gliding across the vanishing-edge pool toward the illuminated glass façade
rooms.subtitleFa: حرکت روی استخر بی‌نهایت به سمت نمای شیشه‌ای نورانی
rooms.ambientDescription: The film opens at blue hour: the camera skims the mirror-calm infinity pool, the residence glowing in layered cove lighting beyond the water.
rooms.ambientDescriptionFa: فیلم در ساعت آبی آغاز می‌شود؛ دوربین روی آب آرام استخر بی‌نهایت سُر می‌خورد و عمارت با نورپردازی پنهان در آن‌سوی آب می‌درخشد.

hotspots.title: Floor-to-Ceiling Glass Curtain Wall
hotspots.description: A seamless 40-meter glazed façade engineered for coastal salt air, dissolving the boundary between pool terrace and great room.

hotspots.title: Architectural Cove Lighting Scene
hotspots.description: Programmable Lutron scene lighting traces the roofline and pool basin, choreographed to dusk for maximum drama.

materials.name: Midnight Quartz Pool Interior
materials.description: A deep sapphire-quartz finish turns the pool into liquid onyx at dusk, mirroring the illuminated residence.

materials.name: Honed Basalt Pool Deck
materials.description: Velvet-smooth volcanic basalt stays cool underfoot beside the water and deepens the monolithic palette.

rooms.name: Oceanfront Grand Salon
rooms.subtitle: Sunken lounge, fire tables and the concert piano beneath the ocean panorama
rooms.subtitleFa: لانژ سان‌کن، میزهای آتش و پیانوی کنسرت زیر پانورامای اقیانوس
rooms.ambientDescription: The heart of the residence: a double-bay great room where modular lounge seating circles sculptural fire tables and a grand piano waits at the glass.
rooms.ambientDescriptionFa: قلب عمارت: گریت‌رومی دوبخشی که مبل‌های مدرن دور میزهای آتش چیده شده‌اند و پیانوی گند در کنار شیشه منتظر است.

hotspots.title: Sculptural Fire Tables
hotspots.description: Cast-stone fire tables anchor the conversation pits, mixing live flame with the cool palette of stone and linen.

hotspots.title: Concert Grand Piano
hotspots.description: A polished grand piano sits on the ocean axis — the salon doubles as an intimate recital hall at sunset.

materials.name: Ivory Bouclé Lounge Seating
materials.description: Modular bouclé sofas wrap the fire pits in soft, tactile ivory — comfort engineered to the tune of 100,000 rubs.

materials.name: Battened Oak Ceiling
materials.description: Slim oak battens space the ceiling and conceal linear AC and acoustic damping above the salon.

rooms.name: Glass Façade Reveal
rooms.subtitle: The full modern pavilion comes into frame across the reflecting water
rooms.subtitleFa: نمای کامل عمارت مدرن در قاب آب انعکاسی
rooms.ambientDescription: The approach widens: symmetrical pavilions, floating roof planes and the glass great room arrive together in one composed frame.
rooms.ambientDescriptionFa: زاویه باز می‌شود: پاویون‌های متقارن، سقف‌های شناور و گریت‌روم شیشه‌ای در یک قاب واحد ظاهر می‌شوند.

hotspots.title: Cantilevered Roof Planes
hotspots.description: Deep roof overhangs appear to float on razor-thin fascia lines, shading the glass while framing ocean views.

hotspots.title: ROYAL PALM Brand Film
hotspots.description: This master film is the estate’s signature brand asset — the same footage powers every chapter of the interactive tour.

materials.name: Mineral White Render
materials.description: Breathable mineral stucco keeps the volumes crisp white through coastal humidity without cracking.

materials.name: Vanishing-Edge Weir Wall
materials.description: A knife-edge weir lets the pool surface merge with the horizon line from every principal room.

rooms.name: Private Suite 7
rooms.subtitle: Luxury bespoke living space
rooms.subtitleFa: Luxury bespoke living space
rooms.ambientDescription: Seamless modern design with floor-to-ceiling glass and smart automated environment controls.
rooms.ambientDescriptionFa: Modern architecture with panoramic glazing and smart automation.

hotspots.title: Custom Italian Joinery
hotspots.description: Hand-finished walnut millwork with integrated LED reveal detailing.
hotspots.descriptionFa: Handcrafted walnut cabinetry with indirect linear LED reveals.

materials.name: Calacatta Borghini Marble
materials.description: Prestigious white marble with honey gold veining.
materials.descriptionFa: Prestigious white marble with warm honey-gold veining.

rooms.name: The Threshold Entry
rooms.subtitle: Crossing the glass line into the warm ocean-view interior
rooms.subtitleFa: عبور از خط شیشه به فضای گرم داخل
rooms.ambientDescription: The cut lands inside the entry gallery: the same dusk sky now framed by the interior, water views pulling straight through the house.
rooms.ambientDescriptionFa: نما داخلی می‌شود: همان آسمان غروب حالا از داخل قاب شده و نمای آب مستقیم از یک‌سوی خانه به سوی دیگر ادامه دارد.

hotspots.title: Straight-Line Ocean Axis
hotspots.description: Entry, gallery and great room share one unbroken sightline to the Pacific — the estate’s organizing gesture.

materials.name: Wide-Plank White Oak Floors
materials.description: Continuous oak runs from threshold to great room, hiding expansion joints for an unbroken plane.

rooms.name: Sunset Panorama Wall
rooms.subtitle: The camera drifts along 18 meters of uninterrupted ocean glass
rooms.subtitleFa: دوربین در امتداد ۱۸ متر شیشه بی‌وقفه رو به اقیانوس حرکت می‌کند
rooms.ambientDescription: Every seat owns the horizon: the drift reveals the full panorama wall, palm silhouettes and the last light on the water.
rooms.ambientDescriptionFa: هر صندلی رو به افق است: حرکت دوربین کل دیوار پانوراما، سایه نخل‌ها و آخرین نور روی آب را نشان می‌دهد.

hotspots.title: 18-Meter Seamless Ocean Glass
hotspots.description: Sliding glass bays retract fully into pockets, converting the salon into an open-air pavilion in under a minute.

materials.name: Bronze-Anodized Slider Frames
materials.description: Slim bronze sightlines keep the panorama photographically clean and resist salt-air corrosion.

rooms.name: Evening in the Salon
rooms.subtitle: Firelight, deep seating and the estate at its most cinematic hour
rooms.subtitleFa: نور آتش، نشیمن گرم و سینمایی‌ترین ساعت عمارت
rooms.ambientDescription: The film closes on the salon at night: flames reflected in the glass, the Pacific gone deep blue, the residence fully itself.
rooms.ambientDescriptionFa: فیلم با سالن در شب تمام می‌شود: بازتاب شعله‌ها روی شیشه، اقیانوس آبی عمیق و عمارت در اوج اقتدار.

hotspots.title: Evening Scene Programming
hotspots.description: One tap shifts the estate to its night scene: fires ignite, cove lighting warms, and the panorama glows against the dark.

materials.name: Aged Brass Accent Hardware
materials.description: Unlacquered brass details catch the firelight and deepen gracefully with the coastal air.

broker.name: Alexandra Whitmore
broker.title: Senior Vice President of Luxury Estates
